content.title: Analyst: Commonwealth Attrition From LPL Slowing
content.summary: Raymond James has been the biggest beneficiary of Commonwealth attrition so far, followed by Kestra and Cambridge Investment Research, according to Wolfe Research.

content.title: Assessing LPL Financial After Analyst Upgrades and a 3.5% Weekly Price Jump
content.summary: Curious if LPL Financial Holdings is trading at a fair price, or if there's an opportunity waiting to be seized? You're not alone. Valuing this stock is top of mind for many investors right now. LPL shares have seen plenty of movement lately. The price is up 3.5% this week but down 5.6% over the past month. Year-to-date, the stock is still up a healthy 8.5% and has posted an impressive 259.9% gain over five years. Much of this momentum comes as investors respond to changing market dynamics...

content.title: $1B Broker/Dealer Dempsey Lord Smith Moves to Cambridge
content.summary: Founder and CEO Jerry Dempsey is dropping the firm’s broker/dealer status to partner with Cambridge on the thesis that running a broker/dealer is “no longer required” for growth and scale.

content.title: LPL Financial Reports a Rise in October Brokerage & Advisory Assets
content.summary: LPLA's October assets climb to $2.35T, with both brokerage and advisory balances rising and organic inflows supporting momentum.

content.title: Deals & Moves: Insigneo Lands Raymond James Team; $5B PFG Moves to United Planners
content.summary: In addition, The Mather Group acquires a California-based firm, the AmeriFlex Group recruits two teams from the Commonwealth, and Snowden Lane snags an Osaic advisor.

content.title: LPL Financial Acquires Minority Stake in Private Advisor Group
content.summary: LPLA deepens its RIA ties with a new minority stake in Private Advisor Group, aiming to boost advisor support and long-term growth.

content.title: Wells Fargo, Robinhood Top New Rankings for Digital Wealth Management
content.summary: New J.D. Power rankings of customer satisfaction with financial websites and apps credits top performers with sleek and intuitive designs that didn’t pile on too many features.

content.title: LPL Financial Buys Stake in Private Advisor Group, a $41 Billion Wealth Manager
content.summary: LPL joins Private Advisor Group’s other backer, Merchant Investment Management, which bought a minority stake in the wealth management company in 2021.

content.title: LPL Stakes $41B Super OSJ Private Advisor Group
content.summary: The hybrid RIA was looking for a capital partner that was an operator, as well as a way to better align with LPL, which has been a business partner for 28 years.

content.title: Osaic Adds Teams From Commonwealth, LPL With $809M in Assets
content.summary: Osaic adds True Wealth Advisors, an Englewood, Colo.-based group with five advisors and $705 million in client assets, and Soundview Financial Group, a Tacoma, Wash.-based practice with about $104 million in assets.
